objective: Add a module `demo_app/semver.py` with a function `parse_version(text: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]` that turns a `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` string into a tuple of three ints. A single leading `v` is allowed (`v1.2.3`). Surrounding whitespace is ignored.
acceptance: Text with fewer or more than three dot-separated parts, an empty string, or a non-numeric part raises ValueError
A negative number or a part with a sign (for example '1.-2.3' or '+1.2.3') raises ValueError
